mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has risen by >0.2pp and FEDFUNDS has fallen by >0.1pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 600,000 units (HOUST > 600.0), it signals robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has been above 600.0 for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 550,000 units (HOUST < 550.0), it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has been below 550.0 for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5pp and HOUST falls > 10.0 units in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has fallen by >0.5pp and HOUST has fallen by >10.0 units over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%), rising consumer price inflation erodes real corporate profits and forces monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY inflation has exceeded 2.5% for at least 3 consecutive months.
